page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: regi, polemarcho, thesmothetis, tum in iure dicundo, tum in aliis reipublicæ negociis curandis specialius & certius quàm fuerant antè, à Solone descriptæ. Præmium omnibus magistratus hujus probè ac fine vitio gesti tributum ab eodem, adscriptio in Areopagitas, quo-rum honos cum amplissimo munere erat perpetuus. Præter hoc ix.virûm collegium, de quo dicendum rursus, ubi de magistratibus hujus reipublicæ va-riis & multis agetur, Solon distincta in civitate concilia esse voluit, præcipua nempe & maxima ejus membra, ex quorum apta compagine reipublicæ à se ordinatæ forma existeret. Horum amplissimum erat Concio, in quam coibat universus populus, & cujus erat suprema in civitate potestas : de qua etiam plura suo loco. Huic verò tan-quam grandi navi fluctuationi & tem-pestatibus obnoxiæ alia duo adjuncta fuêre velut ancoræ ejus, ut loquitur Plutarchus, quæ proprie senatuum ti-tulo afficiebantur. Eorum alter aliquo-ties jam memoratus, ex loco, ubi con-ventus & confessus sedem habebat, A-reopagiticus fuit nuncupatus : quem ante Solonem in civitate non fuisse veterum quidam videntur existimasse. Cicero quippe lib. 1. off. sic ait : Lac[?]

page.notes: The last line is cut off by the lower page edge; "Lac[?]" is the visible part and the catchword "det[?]" at lower right is partly hidden and uncertain. The text is faint in places, especially the right edge of several lines. "Concio" reads as "Conc10" in the scan and was read as Concio. The long s throughout (e.g. "fuerant", "fpecialius", "exiftimaffe") was normalised to s as instructed. The dark area on the right is the book's edge and was not transcribed.
